chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn Za'lan, from al-Husayn ibn Bashaar, from Hisham ibn al-Muthanna and Hanaan, said:

We performed Tawaf by the House, the Tawaf of the women, and we forgot the two Raka'at. So when we arrived at Mina, we remembered them, so we went to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and asked him, and he said: 'Pray them at Mina.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, a title for Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaf al-Nisa', the Tawaf performed specifically by women or the general Tawaf of the women of the Prophet
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a holy site near Mecca

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for missed prayers after Tawaf if remembered later during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the principle of *al-khata'* (mistake) in ritual worship, where the Imam (peace be upon him) validates the validity of the missed two Raka'at by commanding their performance at the place of remembrance, here Mina. It highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the timing and location of compensatory prayers (*Qada*) when a pilgrim is in a state of travel or ritual consecration (*Ihram*), emphasizing that the error does not invalidate the preceding Tawaf. This ruling underscores the practical ease (*Taysir*) granted to worshippers in Hajj rituals, ensuring that minor omissions do not become burdensome obstacles to the completion of the pilgrimage.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn Za’lan, from Al Husayn Bin Bashaar, from Hisham Bin Al Musna, and Hanaan, both said,

‘We performed Tawaaf by the House (Kaaba), the Tawaaf of the women (طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ), and we forgot the two Cycles (to be Prayed). So when we went to Mina, we remembered these. So we went over to Abu Abdullahasws and asked himasws. So heasws said: ‘Pray these at Mina’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn al-Za’lan from al-Husayn ibn Bashshar from Hisham ibn al- Muthanna’ and Hanan who have said the following:

“We performed Tawaf al-Nisa’ around the House but forgot the two Rak‘at Salat (prayer). When we arrived in Mina’, we remembered the two Rak‘at Salat (prayer). We then went to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and asked him about it. He (the Imam) said, ‘You must perform them in Mina’.’”
